items.exampleEn: A news helicopter flew over the city to film the parade.
items.exampleZh: 一架新聞直升機飛過城市上空拍攝遊行。

items.exampleEn: We rented a trailer to move our furniture to the new house.
items.exampleZh: 我們租了拖車，把家裡的東西搬到新家。

items.exampleEn: Thousands of people gathered at the beach to watch the rocket launch.
items.exampleZh: 數千人聚集在海灘觀看火箭發射。

items.exampleEn: The expedition reached the river after walking through the jungle for twelve days.
items.exampleZh: 探險隊在叢林裡走了十二天後，終於抵達那條河。

items.exampleEn: The anchor got stuck between two rocks, and the sailors couldn't pull it up.
items.exampleZh: 錨卡在兩塊石頭之間，水手們拉不上來。

items.exampleEn: Her brother is a cook in the navy and spends months at sea.
items.exampleZh: 她哥哥在海軍當廚師，常常好幾個月都在海上。

items.exampleEn: The library added a ramp at the entrance for wheelchairs.
items.exampleZh: 圖書館在入口加了一條輪椅坡道。

items.exampleEn: Water boils at a lower temperature at high altitude.
items.exampleZh: 在高海拔的地方，水的沸點比較低。

items.sentenceEn: The plane is now flying at an altitude of ten thousand meters.
items.sentenceZh: 飛機現在在一萬公尺的高度飛行。

items.audioEn: The rescue helicopter will land on the hospital roof in about five minutes.
items.audioZh: 救援直升機大約五分鐘後會降落在醫院屋頂。
options: At the airport near the city

items.sentenceEn: The ship anchored near the island so the passengers could swim.
items.sentenceZh: 船在島附近停泊，讓乘客可以去游泳。

items.sentenceEn: Workers pushed the boxes up a ramp into the truck.
items.sentenceZh: 工人把箱子沿著坡道推上卡車。

items.stemEn: The farmer's truck pulled a ____ full of hay.
items.stemZh: 那位農夫的卡車後面拉著一台裝滿乾草的拖車。

items.stemEn: The scientists are planning a long ____ to the highest mountain in the region.
items.stemZh: 科學家們正在規劃一趟前往該地區最高山的考察。

items.passageEn: My aunt works as a photographer, and last year she joined a scientific expedition to the mountains. The team flew to the base camp by helicopter, because the roads were closed by snow. At such a high altitude, everyone felt tired quickly. One evening, the scientists showed my aunt a film about a rocket that carries tools into space. On the way home, she visited a navy museum by the sea, where a huge old anchor stood near the entrance. She says the whole trip was exhausting but unforgettable, and her photos are now on display in a small gallery downtown.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是攝影師，去年她參加了一趟前往山區的科學考察。因為道路被大雪封閉，團隊搭直升機到基地營。在那麼高的海拔，每個人都很快就累了。有一天晚上，科學家們給阿姨看了一部關於火箭把工具送上太空的影片。回家途中，她參觀了海邊的一座海軍博物館，入口附近立著一個巨大的舊錨。她說整趟旅程很累人，卻令人難忘，她的照片現在正在市中心一間小藝廊展出。

questions.questionZh: 團隊為什麼搭直升機到基地營？
海軍博物館入口附近有什麼？

items.promptZh: 我在高海拔的地方很容易覺得累。
referenceEn: I get tired easily at high altitude.
At high altitudes, I feel tired very quickly.
rubricZh: 「在高海拔」可寫，例如 at high altitude、at high altitudes 等

items.promptZh: 這部電影的預告片比電影本身還好看。
referenceEn: The trailer for this movie is better than the movie itself.
This film's trailer was more interesting than the film itself.
rubricZh: trailer 這裡指預告片（例如 the trailer for this movie、this film's trailer 等）
「比…還好看」用比較級（例如 better than、more interesting than 等）
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）
